title: Terminal Mux: Remote streaming addendum + test harness
description:
Implement remote terminal streaming addendum + full test harness from docs/plans/09-h2-termmux-port.add01.md and docs/plans/09-h2-termmux-port-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: Addendum (TerminalSubscription, StreamTerminal RPC, xterm.js compatibility, bandwidth management), test harness (P1-P5, F1-F5, S1-S4, B1-B4, ST1-ST3, SEC1-SEC3)

Key deliverables:
- TerminalSubscription: subscribe to terminal output stream, backpressure handling, client disconnect cleanup
- StreamTerminal RPC: server-streaming endpoint for remote terminal access
- xterm.js compatibility: escape sequence passthrough, resize events, UTF-8 handling
- Bandwidth management: output throttling, buffer limits, slow client detection
- Test harness: property tests (session lifecycle, event ordering), fault injection (PTY crash, driver hang, client disconnect), stress tests (many concurrent sessions, rapid attach/detach), benchmarks (event throughput, PTY latency), security (escape injection, resource exhaustion)
- Integration tests for remote streaming end-to-end

Depends on: Terminal Mux drivers task for AgentMonitor, TermmuxDriverAdapter, driver implementations.
